description: This file defines a foreground Android service called NodeForegroundService, which manages a notification to indicate the status of an OpenClaw node connection, utilizing Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous status updates and handling lifecycle events like start, stop, and destroy.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android foreground service managing node connection status notifications with dynamic updates via coroutines.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes notification channel and starts foreground notification, launches coroutine for runtime status updates.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, specifically stop action, and indicates service should remain running.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up coroutine scope and job on service termination.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates notification channel for connection status notifications.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs the notification object with current status info and action buttons.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates the displayed notification with new content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts foreground service with notification and updates if already started.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Entry point to initiate the service from other app components.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Entry point to stop the service from other app components.
